description: FootageFind evaluation queries. Ground-truth time ranges (seconds from file start) were set by manually inspecting every 0.5 s of vtest.avi and every 0.4 s of indoor_desk.avi (contact sheets), and are independent of any model output. Queries whose ground truth could not be established confidently were dropped (see 'dropped'). A hit counts as correct when its best timestamp lies inside a ground-truth range for the right video, widened by 'tolerance_s' on both sides (half the 2 fps sampling interval).

vtest.avi.notes: 768x576 @ 10 fps, fixed elevated camera over a campus road junction and lawn (PETS-style). Pedestrians only; the white van and cars in the background are parked for the whole clip.

indoor_desk.avi.notes: 1920x1080 @ 25 fps indoor clip: a man in a striped shirt handles toys (duck, clown, ball) on a table. Used as a second 'camera' so cross-video retrieval is tested.

queries.query: a man and a woman walking together on the grass
queries.evidence_note: Couple (man in red/navy jacket, blonde woman in black coat) enters the lawn bottom-right at ~50.5 s and walks across it together; they separate at ~58 s.

queries.query: a woman with curly blonde hair in a long black coat walking alone on the grass
queries.evidence_note: After the man leaves her at ~58 s she walks alone across the lawn, leaving at the left edge ~74.5 s.

queries.query: a woman in a red jacket
queries.evidence_note: Enters right edge at 42 s, crosses to the left edge (gone ~57.5 s); re-appears at left near the cones at 61 s and walks up the back road until the end. Broad ground truth (~70% of the clip): see random baseline.

queries.query: a person in a white hooded jacket
queries.evidence_note: Person in a white/pale-blue hooded jacket enters right at 11.5 s, walks left past the signpost, and leaves the far left at ~21.5 s.

queries.query: a man in a blue jacket and grey trousers
queries.evidence_note: Grey-haired man in a mid-blue jacket enters right at ~65.5 s, walks up-left past the signpost, leaves far left ~74 s.

queries.query: a group of three people standing and talking next to a signpost
queries.evidence_note: Three men stand together at the green signpost from ~2.5 s to ~8.5 s.

queries.query: a person right next to the camera tripod on the grass
queries.evidence_note: The couple passes immediately beside the tripod at 51.5-53 s; the man in the red/navy jacket stands at the tripod at 59.5-61 s.
The lawn is only walked on between 50.5 s (couple arrives) and 74.5 s (blonde woman leaves).

queries.query: a man in a red jacket walking on the grass
queries.evidence_note: Man in red/navy jacket on the lawn from 50.5 s until he steps back onto the road past the tripod at ~61 s.

queries.query: a man in a red jacket walking side by side with a blonde woman on the road
queries.evidence_note: Same couple walks on the road twice: 1.5-12 s (right edge up to the back road) and 26-37.5 s (back road down the right side).

queries.query: a man holding a colourful ball
queries.evidence_note: He lifts the ball at ~4.6 s and holds it until the end.

queries.query: a man with his hand on top of a toy clown
queries.evidence_note: Right hand rests on the clown's head from ~1.4 s to ~3.2 s.

queries.query: a man reaching across the table to pick up a ball
queries.evidence_note: Reaches left for the ball at ~3.7 s, grasps it at 4.2 s, lifts it by 4.6 s.

queries.query: colourful children's toys on a wooden table
queries.evidence_note: Whole indoor clip. Tests picking the right video, not the right moment.

queries.query: a white van parked in front of a brick building
queries.evidence_note: Van is parked at the top of every vtest frame. Tests picking the right video.

queries.query: a man in a striped short-sleeved shirt
queries.evidence_note: Only the indoor clip has a striped short-sleeved shirt; vtest pedestrians wear winter coats.

dropped.reason: At least five different people carry small white papers/bags at many times (1.5-12 s, 23.5 s, 26-37 s, 38-40.5 s, 51-66 s, 70-72 s, 74-79 s); too small at 768x576 to label every instance confidently.

dropped.query: a crowd of people crossing the road
dropped.reason: Subjective; most of the clip qualifies.
No vehicle moves in either clip.

dropped.query: a person carrying a large bag near the gate
dropped.reason: The README's example query; no such event exists in the available test footage, so it cannot be scored.
